name: Greenjaw
place: hunts the deep jungle west of Mistfall; moss grows on its lower jaw and it hides in the vent steam
_doc: Expansion 1 (Vharlen). A jungle cat with moss growing in its jaw. It pounces on whoever stands farthest and lunges down a line. At half health it slips into the vent steam and comes out of it at three players in a row, then circles the group (get in close).

party.solo: Hard solo at 12: the leaps come back to back.
party.m5: M5 adds health per extra player and one more copy of the spread/scatter shapes for parties of 4-5; mechanics stay the same.

pull: The steam parts. Something green-jawed is already moving.
Greenjaw coughs a low growl from the ferns.
say.death: Greenjaw slumps into the ferns. The steam closes over it.
say.reset: Greenjaw melts back into the steam.

leaps.name: Out of the Steam
leaps.say: Greenjaw is in the steam — it could come out at anyone!

circling.name: Circling
circling.say: It circles the group in the steam — close in!

phases.name: Into the Steam
phases.say: Greenjaw vanishes into a gout of vent steam!
